html: † מְעוּנִים n.pr.gent. Meʿunim, Meʿunites (usually connected with מָעוֹן (v. עון), but dub., cf. Buhl Edom. 41 f.);—a people S. (SE?) of Canaan (cf. Buhl l.c.);—הַמּ׳ 2 Ch 26:7 and 1 Ch 4:41 Qr (Kt המעינים, 𝔊B τοὺς Μιναίους, 𝔊L τ. κιναίους); read also מֵהַמְּעוּנִים 2 Ch 20:1 (for MT מֵהָעַמּוֹנִים), so 𝔊Biblical Aramaic (𝔊L Αμμανιειμ), Ew Be Ke Öt Kau Kit; בְּנֵי־מְעוּנִים (among Nethinim who went back with Zerub.) Ezr 2:50=Neh 7:52 are perhaps descendants of those named above (2 Ch 26:7). 𝔊 οἱ Μιναῖοι, but against מ׳=Minæans (GlaserSkizze ii. 450 f. al.) v. SprengerZMG xliv (1890), 505.
